headline: Balancing the growth equation, fuelling investments

highlights: (0.2) (0.2) EBITDA (INR mn) 8,668 10,660 8,442 10,341 % Chng. 2.7 3.1 EPS (INR) 29.9 37.8 29.1 36.4 % Chng. 2.7 3.8 Key Data FRAL.BO | FRACTAL IN BSE Code 544700 NSE Code FRACTAL 52-W High / Low INR 1,119 / INR 696 Face Value 1 Sensex / Nifty 77,301 / 23,961 Market Cap INR 145 bn / $ 1,537 mn Shares Outstanding 174.1 mn 3M Avg.
Growth was led by HLS (+79% YoY) and BFSI (+30% YoY), while TMT returned to sequential growth (+5.6%) after five qtrs. of degrowth, with management expecting a gradual recovery through H2FY27.
In contrast, CPG declined 7.1% QoQ amid vendor consolidation and macro-related challenges, although management expects sequential growth to resume from Q3.

The products business continued to gain traction, with license revenues growing 39% YoY to INR380mn (~4% of rev.), taking the annualized run rate to over INR1.5bn, while product RPO exceeded INR2.0bn.
valuation: Change in Estimates Current Previous FY28E FY29E FY28E FY29E Rating BUY BUY Target Price 1,060 1,020 Sales (INR mn) 46,834 55,267 46,944 55,383 % Chng.
Management is targeting an annualized product rev. run rate of ~USD100mn over the next 12 quarters.
We continue to value the company at 17x EV/EBITDA to arrive at a target price of INR 1,060 and maintain our BUY rating.
